notes: Every scenario starts from the same genesis project: one level, wall W (6 m x 0.2 m x 3.0 m), activity A (8 h), and link K constructing W by A.
Genesis puts every object at version 1 and the log head at 0.
Separated edits: a modeler and a scheduler preview against the same genesis state. Their changes touch disjoint objects, so both commit.
Overlapping edits: two proposals change W's height from the same base. The first commits; the second conflicts on W alone and writes nothing.
Atomic rejection: the third operation sets a negative height, so the whole proposal is rejected at index 2 and the project is unchanged.
No cascades: deleting W while K references it is rejected. Unlinking K and then deleting W in one transaction succeeds.
